name: Georgia Myers
life: “I still remember designing a room that blocked the only kitchen light.” On Monday, near the blocks below Foundry Lofts, Georgia checks the little hand-lettered notices around Harbour Supply.
voice: I build tiny flats. I priced an addition and told everyone whose window it would shadow.
appearance: Georgia has heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw. Look for a center part and straight chestnut hair. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a long navy raincoat with a thin silver ring worn on a cord. In conversation Georgia gathers both sleeves neatly before settling in.
personality: Georgia is cheerful on a bad morning and unexpectedly melancholy after a success. Finishing a hard thing means losing the daily company of the people who worked on it.
agenda: To price an addition without hiding the shadow it casts.
family: Tali Ross is Georgia’s stepsibling. Georgia remembers the birthdays. Tali asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *A clean coat for court*, Tali says, “I work the courthouse door and recognize that coat from its owner's weekly jury-duty arguments.”
connections: Diana Romero. The manager has to see which resident's light a new room would take.

reactions.response: Georgia checks that the tree can survive the move before it is lifted.
